summary: RFC 6513 describes using a partial mesh of multipoint-to-multipoint tunnels to carry bidirectional customer multicast in MPLS/BGP IP VPNs. This standards-track RFC specifies how to simulate that partial mesh using ingress replication, which lets a provider use that approach without needing multipoint-to-multipoint tunnel support in the network.

eli5.summary: Instead of one shared delivery truck for everyone, the sender makes copies and sends a separate package to each receiver. It acts the same for the people getting the packages.
